title: MessageEnvelope
description: Server-to-client realtime message. Clients dispatch on message_type and must log-and-ignore unknown types. Type schemas compose this with allOf and close the object with unevaluatedProperties:false.

message_id.description: Server-generated UUIDv7 for tracing and log correlation.

tick.description: Server simulation tick when the message was produced.

correlation_id.description: Gameplay transaction this message belongs to, or null. Reply matching uses explicit payload fields (e.g. command_id), not this field.
